question: In which of the following cities was the Sepak Takraw 2025 World Cup (ISTAF) held in India in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Patna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sepak Takraw 2025 World Cup was held in **Patna, Bihar**, marking India's growing prominence in hosting international sports events.
 
• The event took place in **March 2025**, attracting teams from various countries globally to compete in this traditional Southeast Asian sport.
 
• Patna was chosen for its **modern infrastructure** and increasing focus on sports development in the state of Bihar.
 
• Sepak Takraw, also known as kick volleyball, has been gaining popularity in India, with Patna hosting the event as a key effort to promote the sport nationally.
 
• The International Sepak Takraw Federation (ISTAF) organized the event, ensuring adherence to international standards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sepak Takraw**:

 
 
• A traditional Southeast Asian sport combining elements of soccer and volleyball.
 
• Played with a rattan ball, participants use their feet, head, knees, and chest to hit the ball over the net.
 
• The game is particularly popular in countries like Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines.
 
 
 
• **International Sepak Takraw Federation (ISTAF)**:
 
 
• The governing body of Sepak Takraw, responsible for organizing global tournaments such as the World Cup.
 
• ISTAF promotes the sport across various nations, encouraging participation and development.
 
• It establishes rules and regulations to ensure fair play and global uniformity in the sport.
 
 
 
• **India’s Growth in Hosting Sports Events**:
 
 
• India has emerged as a preferred destination for international sports events due to improved infrastructure and organizational capabilities.
 
• Hosting such events boosts tourism, local economy, and sports culture.
 
• Other notable events held in India include the Cricket World Cup and Kabaddi World Cup.
 
 
 
• **Bihar’s Development in Sports**:
 
 
• Patna has witnessed significant growth in sports infrastructure, hosting events that attract international attention.
 
• Bihar's government is actively promoting sports to inspire youth participation and engagement.
